svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Minimal Local Tag logo, v3
svg.desc: A deliberately unlettered version of the chosen tag, with its transparent tag hole and connected lower map-pin point. The companion lockup retains the full display name. Paired with the exact Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
